description: HVAC Services: Heating and Air Conditioning Center is a specialized service facility located in San Leandro, California, serving the East Bay community with professional heating and cooling solutions. Despite its name suggesting a shopping mall, this location operates primarily as an HVAC service center, offering installation, maintenance, and repair services for residential and commercial climate control systems. The facility maintains convenient operating hours from 11:30 AM to 8:30 PM, making it accessible for customers seeking after-work service appointments. With a solid 3.9-star rating from nearly 5,000 reviews, the center has established itself as a reliable resource for Bay Area residents dealing with heating and air conditioning needs. Located on East 14th Street, a major commercial corridor in San Leandro, the facility serves the diverse communities of Alameda County with professional HVAC expertise.
